task.title: Task form: stop Depends On offering tasks this one already blocks
task.description: Depends On still offers tasks that this task already blocks; adding one would be a cycle and the server refuses it. Both kinds share one list, so those tasks sit right above the picker. Also check whether the picker's highlighted option still resets on the one-second refresh after arrow-key moves. (The lost focus on the remove control and the focus drop after an add were fixed in PR #205.)
